0.role-notes: Extended by the CRTM/firmware with measurements of the firmware itself. Value depends on board vendor + BIOS/UEFI version.

derived.note: LapEE does not yet transport the IMA per-file event log in the envelope; only PCR 10's final value is signed. Future `~tpm2@2.0a' versions will include it.

10.role-notes: Extended by the Linux IMA subsystem with every exec'd binary matching the active ima_policy. Tracks the runtime integrity history of userspace.

11.role-notes: Extended by systemd-stub / sd-boot for the UKI's kernel image PE hashes. Pins the kernel+initrd identity to a signed image.

15.role-notes: LapEE node identity. Extended at HB startup via the enforced `on.start' hook with the SHA-256 native id of the running node message. Uniquely identifies this boot's HB configuration.

7.role-notes: Extended with Secure Boot state + the PK/KEK/db/dbx keyset. A legitimate SB-enabled boot produces a non-zero value; a zero value means Secure Boot was off during this boot.
